message: たがためにスタミナを

name: Misa
message: 「Here, check the planned equipment layout for the dance venue.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Looks great.」

name: Ria
message: 「With this, all the students will be able to dance at the same time.」

name: Synn
message: 「And we somehow managed to secure the lighting equipment too... *cough, cough*」
I just can't seem to shake this cold.

name: Ria
message: 「Are you okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「Your cold still hasn't cleared up?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you gonna say that since Synn isn't in top shape, you'll be acting Student Council President until he recovers?」

name: Misa
message: 「I won't say that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehh!? Where did that Vice President who was practically drooling with lust for power go!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't say things that make me sound so awful.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Luckily, tomorrow's Sunday, so take it easy and rest. I'll bring over some stamina-boosting food or something. Enough for Azel, Sally-chan, and the panda too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Jeez, saying it with such a straight face.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You coming to keep watch or what.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Am not! I'm just genuinely worried about him.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-How shameless, Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh!? *hack, hack*」

name: Misa
message: 「You're planning to do something on Sunday that requires stamina-boosting food, aren't you! And with Azel-san and Sally-san, a threesome!」

name: Misa
message: 「A-And even involving Paqy-san! H-How filthy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「By the way, I take the back.」

name: Misa
message: 「T-The back! By 'the back,' you mean... N-Noooooooo!」

name: Ria
message: 「What does 'the back' mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really know about the back, either. It's not just me--Azel isn't feeling too well either. *cough, cough*」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What, so that's what it was.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What did you think the three of us were doing?」

name: Misa
message: 「How should I know!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even Synn wouldn't do farm work when he's coming down with a cold.」

name: Ria
message: 「Is Azel-chan feeling unwell? I haven't seen her around today... Could she be taking the day off?」

name: Synn
message: 「No. She's at the academy. Though she said she's almost finished.」

name: Ria
message: 「With the photos?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. She's probably running all over the academy right about now. Even though I told her she should rest.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She looked pale when I saw her this morning, so I told her she should rest too. Azel's just so stubborn.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even so, it's worrying.」

name: Synn
message: 「We're meeting up on the way back too, so I'll make sure to walk her all the way home.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... maybe this really is bad.」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing!」

name: Ria
message: 「Winter colds drag on, so she really ought to get it cured properly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Tomorrow I intend to throw my weight around as the landlord, not let her take a single step outside, and have her focus on recovering.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did I say something weird?」

name: Misa
message: 「Authority, huh......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't have any.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure don't.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's okay. You're doing a great job as Student Council President, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「What about as a landlord?」
